Around the end of the [[Clone Wars]], a cataclysmic event caused the '''destruction''' of the [[planet]] [[Anaxes]], and the world's shattered remains formed an [[Anaxes asteroid belt|asteroid belt]]. The cataclysm was theorized to have been caused by a [[Anaxes shipyards|shipyard's]] main [[reactor]] failing, igniting a [[hypermatter]] stockpile that destroyed the [[planet]]. One remnant of the planet, designated [[PM-1203]], was the original site of [[Fort Anaxes]], a military installation used by the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Battle of Anaxes]] during the [[Clone Wars]] that miraculously survived the cataclysm. Following this event, the facility became a [[fuel]] depot.

==Prelude==
[[Anaxes]], a terrestrial [[planet]] home to [[Anaxes shipyards|important shipyards]],<ref name="The Bad Batch">{{TCW|The Bad Batch (episode)}}</ref> had previously been threatened with destruction during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Unfinished Business">{{TCW|Unfinished Business (episode)}}</ref> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date 2">{{TCWcanondates|704}}</ref> the final [[Standard year|year]] of the conflict between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the Separatists launched an [[Battle of Anaxes|attack]] on Anaxes led by [[Admiral]] [[Trench]]. The [[Confederacy military|Separatist forces]] initially had the upper hand due to having gained access to a secret, highly-effective [[Rex's battle strategy algorithm|Republic strategy algorithm]]<ref name="The Bad Batch" /> from a captured [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]], [[Echo]].<ref name="Unfinished Business" />

After [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] and [[Clone Force 99]] [[Mission to Skako Minor (Clone Wars)|rescued]] Echo,<ref name="OtWoK">{{TCW|On the Wings of Keeradaks}}</ref> the Republic launched a counterattack against the Separatists. When it became clear the [[battle droid]]s were being driven back, Trench activated his backup plan: "total annihilation" in the form of a [[bomb]] hidden in the [[Anaxes assembly complex|assembly complex]] which was powerful enough to destroy most of the planet. With the help of Skywalker and Echo, [[Jedi]] [[General]] [[Mace Windu]] was able to disarm the bomb, and Skywalker [[Death|killed]] Trench and blew up his [[flagship]], ''[[Invulnerable]]'', ending the threat the [[Harch]] had posed.<ref name="Unfinished Business" /> However, a [[Separatist stronghold (PM-6986)|Separatist stronghold]] still remained on the planet.<ref name="Dawn" />

The Clone Wars ended later that year<ref name="SWGA" /> with the [[Proclamation of the New Order|reorganization]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Great Jedi Purge|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Order]], which was falsely accused of [[treason]] by [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]], publicly [[Supreme Chancellor]] and [[Galactic Emperor]] Palpatine. The new [[Emperor]] promised to bring about a new era of "peace" for [[the galaxy]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==The destruction==
Around the end of the Clone Wars,<ref name="Date 1" /> Anaxes was destroyed in a cataclysmic event.<ref name="Fort Anaxes" /> All that remained of the planet was an [[Anaxes asteroid belt|asteroid belt]].<ref name="Out of Darkness" /> [[Fort Anaxes]], a [[Republic Military]] base which had been the Republic's headquarters during the Battle of Anaxes, miraculously survived the cataclysm on a new [[planetoid]]<ref name="Fort Anaxes" /> which was later designated [[PM-1203]].<ref name="Ezra's Duel with Danger">''[[Ezra's Duel with Danger]]''</ref> The Separatist stronghold also survived on the planetoid [[PM-6986]]. It was theorized that the cataclysm had been caused by a shipyard main [[reactor]] failing and igniting a [[hypermatter]] stockpile.<ref name="Dawn" />

==Aftermath==
Fort Anaxes was abandoned for military purposes after the cataclysm and became a [[fuel]] depot,<ref name="Fort Anaxes" /> which was also occasionally used by [[smuggler]]s or rebels such as the [[Spectres]] for supply drops.<ref name="Out of Darkness" />

==Behind the scenes==
The destruction of Anaxes was first mentioned in Fort Anaxes' [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry, which went online<ref name="Fort Anaxes" /> after the airing of the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season One|first season]] episode "[[Out of Darkness]]," the first appearance of the fort itself.<ref name="Out of Darkness" />

[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]<ref name="Ultimate">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> and [[Dawn of Rebellion]] state that the destruction of Anaxes happened within the Clone Wars.<ref name="Dawn" /> However the Databank entry of Fort Anaxes<ref name="Fort Anaxes" /> and [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 2]] place the event after the end of the Clone Wars.<ref name="Helmet">[[Star Wars Helmet Collection 2|''Star Wars Helmet Collection'': Boba Fett]]</ref>
